The memo accurately represents all key financial terms found in the source document:
- Deal size of $25,000,000 matches the commitment amount for CoBank, ACB
- Dates (May 13, 2022 for the supplement and March 11, 2022 for the original credit agreement) are correct
- Party names (Texas-New Mexico Power Company as borrower, CoBank ACB as new lender, KeyBank National Association as administrative agent) are accurate
- References to the Sixteenth Supplemental Indenture and Replacement First Mortgage Bonds are supported
- The memo appropriately indicates "N/A" for financial terms not provided in the source document (interest rates, maturity dates, payment frequency, etc.) rather than speculating or adding unsupported information

All substantive financial and transaction details in the memo are directly supported by the source document.

MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo appropriately captures all the key financial terms available in the source document. The source document is an increase supplement that only contains:
- Deal size ($25,000,000)
- Parties (Texas-New Mexico Power Company as Borrower, CoBank ACB as new lender, KeyBank as Administrative Agent)
- Transaction date (May 13, 2022)
- Reference to collateral structure (First Mortgage Bonds)

The memo correctly notes "N/A" for terms like interest rates, maturity dates, payment frequency, and detailed covenant terms because these are not specified in this increase supplement document - they would be found in the underlying credit agreement. The memo also appropriately acknowledges this limitation by noting "Limited Visibility" due to the supplement format rather than full credit agreement.
